name: Cu8Zr5
_status: REAL DFT RESULT (converged) - but surface-dominated; DO NOT substitute directly as dE_ico. See _note.

source.run: relax, BFGS, converged in 16 ionic steps (bfgs converged)
source.settings: ibrav=0, 16 A cubic box, ecutwfc=50 Ry, ecutrho=400 Ry, MP smearing degauss=0.01, Gamma point, forc_conv_thr=1.0d-3
source.host: ASU Sol (HPC cluster), run from tier1_cluster_upload/

_note: E0_eV is the per-atom energy of the FREE 13-atom Cu-centered icosahedron relaxed in vacuum. 12 of 13 atoms are surface, so E0 sits ~+1.58 eV/atom (+152 kJ/mol) above the crystalline hull (lever rule Cu8Zr3/Cu10Zr7). That is a cluster surface energy, ~30x the liquidus-calibrated amorphous offset (~52 meV/atom) and far beyond dE_ico.py's own +150 meV/atom sanity ceiling. The Zentropy driving force needs the DENSE amorphous (bulk-like, no free surface) icosahedral offset, which comes from the glass SCF route (glass_static.py -> scf_glass.out -> dE_ico.py), not this free cluster. thetaD not computed (relax only, no EOS scan); soft1 already set to 0.80 from the phonon VDOS.
